title: Find the full names of members who have a t-shirt size of 'X-Large' and inc
question: Find the full names of members who have a t-shirt size of 'X-Large' and incurred approved expenses in either the 'Food' or 'Advertisement' budget categories, where the associated event has a status of 'Open'. Only include expenses from 2019 or 2020.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_035", T1."XCL_036"
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_022"
INNER JOIN budget AS T3 ON T2."XCL_023" = T3."XCL_003"
INNER JOIN event AS T4 ON T3."XCL_009" = T4."XCL_010"
WHERE T1."XCL_039" = 'X-Large'
  AND T2."XCL_021" = 'true'
  AND T3."XCL_004" IN ('Food', 'Advertisement')
  AND T4."XCL_016" = 'Open'
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', T2."XCL_019") = '2019' OR STRFTIME('%Y', T2."XCL_019") = '2020')
